verdict.reason: E1 beats direct obstruction false-negative rate at T<=3 by the material margin and beats spline/linear FVC recovery at T<=3.
verdict.physics_vs_smoothness_sentence: E1 beats the spline and linear-tail baselines at T=2 and T=3, so the bi-exponential form is doing work beyond generic smooth extrapolation.
verdict.biexponential_vs_mono_sentence: E1 beats the mono-exponential at T=2 and T=3, so the two-compartment structure is load-bearing.

truth_crosscheck.pass_rule: PASS if median absolute FEV1 and FVC percent errors <=5% and median absolute ratio error <=0.02.

honesty_checks.note: For truncated rows, every estimator used only volume samples up to T and a fixed 12 s prediction horizon. The true complete-curve duration was not used by the fit.

estimator_definitions.E1_OMBE: Two-compartment OMBE fit to volume samples up to T; FVC is model volume at the fixed 12 s horizon.
estimator_definitions.E2_SPLINE: Cubic smoothing spline fit to samples up to T; FVC is evaluated at the fixed 12 s horizon.
estimator_definitions.E3_LINEAR_TAIL: Line fit to the final 1.0 s before T; FVC is evaluated at the fixed 12 s horizon.
estimator_definitions.E4_MONO_EXPONENTIAL: Single exponential with onset rise fit like E1; FVC is model volume at the fixed 12 s horizon.
